title: Buffers in production
bodyMd: A factory reduces average inventory by receiving components daily. Storage costs decline. During a supplier interruption, however, production stops sooner than it did under the old system. The operations director says that inventory had served both as a cost and as a buffer. She proposes distinguishing predictable daily variation from rare interruptions when deciding which components need reserve stock.
